data.name: Brijkishore
data.gender_notes: Brijkishore is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Brij means 'Lord' and Kishore means 'Youth' or 'Young Man'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Brihkut' which means 'bridge'. Brij is also a name of a renowned holy city in India, Brindavan, which is known as the 'Lord of the Bridge'. Thus, Brijkishore signifies the one who is the Lord of the Bridge or the protector of the people.
data.etymology: Brijkishore belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Bridge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Brijkishore total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
